release_name: Movie destination folders and Plex folder translations
highlights: Movie destination folders configured on the TV Manager server; most free space or in order, free-space reserve, upgrades stay put
Per-Plex-server folder translations: targeted scan in each server's own path; without one, all movie libraries on that server are scanned
Plex library paths no longer decide where files go; v18.30 Plex-path check removed

pytest.skip_reason: Windows-only PowerShell, updater lock and service checks not runnable on the Linux build host; suite also runs on the GitHub Windows runner

validation.auto_update_end_to_end: Not re-run (updater unchanged apart from the default version)
validation.powershell: Not re-run (scripts unchanged apart from the default version)
validation.windows_activation: Not performed: scheduled-task registration, boot start, account rights and share access must be confirmed on the server
validation.browser_qa: Chrome on a disposable copy, desktop and 400px: destination folders with free space, per-server Plex translation editor, add and save a translation; no page errors
validation.indexer_end_to_end: Not performed for movies: search, SABnzbd/BitTorrent handoff, import and Plex scan are covered by fixtures only; confirm the first movie downloads on the server
validation.trash_end_to_end: Temporary library folder: upgrade, duplicate cleanup and retention into share trash, restore (rollback and retention re-attach), empty selected/all/old server trash, fixed folder, validation

activation: Update with update-server.ps1 from the v18.31.0 tag, start with run.ps1, then Movies > Settings: enter destination folders, add Plex folder translations where names differ, and move earlier imports.
